title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Ledger Standard: Registry Credit Value of a Returned Gift
content:
**Standard.** The registry credit of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry for a returned registry gift is the amount of the gift's guest gift entry, the price the guest paid net of the guest's Finch Notes, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

**Which entry is read.** The registrant's most recently authorized return record in received status names the guest's purchase record of the gift; the guest gift entry on the registry carrying that purchase record gives the amount.

| Element | Source |
|---|---|
| Returned gift | the registrant's most recently authorized return record in received status |
| Amount | the registry's guest gift entry for that purchase record: the unit price the guest paid less the guest's Finch Notes, before tax |
| Rounding | once, half up to the cent, on the final amount |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A guest paid USD 92.00 for a gift and applied USD 5.60 of Finch Notes; the guest gift entry shows USD 86.40. When the registrant's return of that gift has been received, the registry credit for it is USD 86.40.
